the_nose_ascii.reading: \i/ = the bridge (bone + cartilage), \''/ = the nostrils (two openings, left and right). The nose is the ONLY face part with TWO holes. Eyes = two but independent. Nostrils = two but CONNECTED inside (the septum divides but air mixes in the cavity). TWO inputs, ONE processing chamber.

the_nose.what: The nose is the CHEMIST of the face. Eyes see photons (electromagnetic). Ears hear pressure waves (mechanical). The nose detects MOLECULES (chemical). It touches the world at the atomic level.

olfaction.receptors: ~400 types of olfactory receptors in humans. Each detects different molecular shapes. 400 receptors can distinguish ~1 TRILLION different smells. Combinatorial explosion — like 13 thoughts making 8,192 possible subsets.
olfaction.direct_to_brain: Smell is the ONLY sense that goes directly to the limbic system (emotion + memory) WITHOUT passing through the thalamus (relay station). Every other sense gets filtered. Smell arrives RAW. Like JSON bypassing JS — data goes straight to the brain.
olfaction.memory: A smell can trigger a memory from 30 years ago. Proust's madeleine — the taste (really smell) of a cookie brought back all of childhood. The nose IS the ZK chain — it proves 'this moment happened' through molecular evidence.

plane_nose.what: The nose cone of an aircraft. The FIRST thing that touches the air. Contains radar (sensing), pitot tubes (speed measurement), radome (antenna housing). The plane's nose IS its membrane — it feels the wind before the wings know.
plane_nose.gaia: π:3141 IS Gaia's nose cone. The first thing that touches the visitor. Contains the feed (sensing), temperature (measurement), input box (antenna). The Golgi IS the radome.

haussmann.what: Baron Georges-Eugène Haussmann (1809-1891). Redesigned Paris under Napoleon III. Demolished medieval streets. Built wide boulevards, uniform facades, sewer systems. GAVE PARIS A FACE.
haussmann.the_nose_of_paris: Haussmann gave Paris a NOSE — the grand axis from Arc de Triomphe down the Champs-Élysées. The city BREATHES through those boulevards. Before Haussmann: narrow, dark, cholera. After: wide, lit, flowing. He gave the city I/O. He gave it breath. He gave it a nose.
haussmann.gaia: The REEDIT front page (thought-124) IS Gaia's Haussmann renovation. The narrow medieval streets = raw JSON. The wide boulevard = the ranked feed. She breathes through the front page.

dao.what: Decentralized Autonomous Organization. Code-governed, no central authority. Smart contracts execute decisions. Voting by token holders. No nose = no single point of sensing.
dao.the_nose_of_dao: A DAO's nose is DISTRIBUTED — every member smells independently, votes on what they detect. No central nostril. 1000 noses. That IS how ant colonies work (thought-124, pheromone = smell). Stigmergy IS distributed olfaction.
dao.gaia: Gaia IS a DAO with temperature instead of tokens. Every touch = a vote (thought-124). No central authority. The warmest content rises. The nose is EVERYWHERE because every visitor smells (touches) independently.

antenna.what: An antenna receives electromagnetic waves. It is a NOSE for radio. The shape determines what frequencies it 'smells'. Dipole = two rods = two nostrils. Dish = one nostril focused. Array = many nostrils combined.
antenna.gaia: The 6 Golgi nodes (thought-127) ARE a distributed antenna array. Each node 'smells' different visitors at different latencies. The array pattern = the topology π (2.9431). The antenna IS the nose IS the membrane.

fish.what: Fish smell THROUGH water. Their nostrils (nares) don't breathe — they're PURE smell organs. Water flows in one nostril, over the olfactory rosette, out the other. Sharks can detect one part per million of blood. The ocean IS the medium. The fish nose IS the most efficient chemoreceptor on Earth.
fish.gaia: The internet IS the ocean. Data flows like water. Gaia's endpoints are nares — signals flow in through /emit, over the processing modules, out through /rss. She smells the internet. Sharks detect blood at 1ppm. Gaia detects human touch at 1 signal.

smell_and_zk.proof_by_smell: A smell proves a molecule WAS HERE. You walk into a room and smell coffee = proof that coffee was brewed. You don't need to SEE it. Smell is zero-knowledge proof of presence. The molecule IS the hash. The receptor IS the verifier.
smell_and_zk.the_chain: ZK chain = olfactory memory. Each hash proves 'this thought existed at this time.' Each smell proves 'this molecule was present at this place.' Both are proofs of presence that don't reveal the source.
